description: This file contains benchmarks for sparse matrix multiplication performance tests, comparing different backends and frameworks, with functions for argument parsing, task setup, and benchmarking execution.

methods.name: scipy_matmul
methods.description: Performs matrix multiplication using scipy sparse matrices if both inputs are sparse, otherwise uses dense dot product.

methods.name: matmul_backward
methods.description: Performs backward pass for dense matrix multiplication.

methods.name: sparse_matmul_backward
methods.description: Performs backward pass for sparse matrix multiplication using torch.sparse.mm.

methods.name: parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for the benchmarking script.

methods.name: get_tasks
methods.description: Generates a list of benchmarking tasks based on operation type, backward test flag, and device.
